source.label: PubMed papers that mention K540E
source.licence: Bibliographic metadata from PubMed; quotes are short excerpts from abstracts, shown with attribution and a link to the source.
notes: This list comes from the Alert tab's data pack at commit a1cc503: PubMed papers whose title or abstract matches the query below.
Countries were machine-read from each abstract and have not been checked by a human.
"Read by the Graph" means the System Public Graph holds findings from that paper (its PubMed ID is in the Graph's CSV snapshot).
Abstracts only: full texts were not read.
Definitions differ between papers, so papers are not one survey series.
Search query (verbatim): ((dhps[tiab] OR pfdhps[tiab] OR dihydropteroate[tiab]) AND (540E[tiab] OR K540E[tiab] OR 540[tiab] OR quintuple[tiab]) OR K540E[tiab]) AND (falciparum[tiab] OR malaria[tiab])

Method (verbatim): Titles and abstracts were read by a language model to pull out explicitly stated K540E prevalence figures, association statements and first-report claims, each with a verbatim quote. A program then kept only items whose quote appears word for word in the abstract and, for prevalence, contains both the stated number and "540". No human checked them.
